headline: Poliomyelitis and Atmospheric Humidity in an Elevated Semiarid Region, Denver, Colorado, 1950 and 1951
source: American Journal of Public Health and the Nation's Health (via PubMed Central)
blurb: This journal article from October 1952 looks at polio and air humidity in Denver in 1950 and 1951.

headline: What’s The History Of Vaccinations In Colorado?
blurb: Colorado enacted its first school-required vaccine laws in 1978, with medical, religious and personal exemptions from the start, according to this 2019 news story.

headline: Measles in a Population with Religious Exemption to Vaccination -- Colorado
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: A 17-year-old at a Colorado camp where the campers and counselors were unvaccinated developed measles on July 24, 1985, and 50 linked cases were later reported, six of them in Colorado.

headline: Interstate Measles Transmission from a Ski Resort -- Colorado, 1994
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: A chain of measles spread that began in Breckenridge in April 1994 reached nine other states and 247 reported cases, which was 36% of U.S. measles cases reported through July 2 of that year.

headline: House Bill 14-1288
source: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
blurb: This Colorado law, passed in May 2014, requires schools to make the immunization and exemption rates of their enrolled students available to the public.

headline: Mumps Outbreak in a Marshallese Community — Denver Metropolitan Area, Colorado, 2016–2017
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: In January 2017, Colorado health officials identified four linked mumps cases among members of one church in the Denver area, and the outbreak reached 47 cases.

headline: Senate Bill 20-163, School Entry Immunization
source: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
blurb: This Colorado law, passed in June 2020, combined the personal belief and religious exemptions into one nonmedical exemption and set a goal that 95% of students in every school be vaccinated.

headline: Measles Outbreak Associated with an Infectious Traveler — Colorado, May–June 2025
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: From May 25 to June 7, 2025, nine Colorado residents got measles after being exposed to a traveler with measles on an international flight or in an airport, one more person caught it from one of them, and four of the ten were hospitalized.
